# Retrieve cached flight results
departure_flights = get_results_from_cache(key="departure_flights")
return_flights = get_results_from_cache(key="return_flights")

# Filter flights for business class
filtered_departure_flights = filter_flights(
    prior_results=departure_flights,
    flight_class=["business"]
)
filtered_return_flights = filter_flights(
    prior_results=return_flights,
    flight_class=["business"]
)

# Save filtered flight results to cache
save_to_cache(key="filtered_departure_flights", value=filtered_departure_flights)
save_to_cache(key="filtered_return_flights", value=filtered_return_flights)

# Search for hotels in St. Louis
hotels = search_hotels(
    city="St. Louis",
    checkin_date=["2025-05-19"],
    checkout_date=["2025-05-24"],
    stars=[2, 2],
    gym_present=True,
    free_wifi_included=True
)

# Save hotel search results to cache
save_to_cache(key="hotels", value=hotels)

# Search for attractions in St. Louis
attractions = search_attractions(
    city="St. Louis",
    type=["Culinary", "City Museum"]
)

# Save attraction search results to cache
save_to_cache(key="attractions", value=attractions)

# Find nearest attractions based on hotels
nearest_attractions = search_nearest(
    hotels=hotels,
    attractions=attractions,
    groupBy="hotel"
)

# Save nearest attractions results to cache
save_to_cache(key="nearest_attractions", value=nearest_attractions)
